profile.name: 数据采集设备
profile.description: 通用实验数据采集设备，用于从实验硬件获取测量数据，并在显微镜成像、数字信号采集或传感器记录等场景中按触发或连续方式输出数据。
profile.description_en: A generic laboratory data acquisition device used to collect measurement data from experimental hardware and output it in triggered or continuous operation, such as in microscopy imaging, digital signal capture, or sensor logging.

registry.name: Data Device
registry.description: Data Device是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括中止、位置设置、使能、写入数据、初始化、功率设置。支持Signal, Slot, add setting等操作。
